review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Engineer Senior
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Manage incident and problem resolution by troubleshooting connectivity, infrastructure, and communication issues and identifying root causes. Maintain hardware and software inventories, network diagrams, technical documentation, and system records to support ongoing operations. Support business resilience efforts by maintaining disaster recovery documentation and participating in Business Resumption Readiness testing. 8+ years of experience with the VMware portfolio, including VCF, SRM, vSAN, NS

review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: 8+ years of experience with the VMware portfolio, including VCF, SRM, vSAN, NSX, and HCX. 5+ years of experience with Terraform Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, configuration management such as Ansible, GitHub Actions, and container solutions. 5+ years of experience with PowerShell, HashiCorp HCL, RESTful APIs, YAML/JSON, and PowerCLI. Preferred 2+ years of experience with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, PKI, and Group Policy. 2+ years of experience with SAN arrays, NAS, Cisco UCS, Dell PowerFlex, and Pure Storage. 2+ years of experience supporting Windows Server and Red Hat operating systems. Why You’ll Love Working Here You’ll have opportunities to grow your technical expertise, mentor others, and influence the direction of technology that supports a leading regional bank.
